summary: Round466 completed a 20,000-game PPO update from Round430 and passed strict perspective-safe rollout audit. On fresh 128-cluster, two-repeat screens it scored 40.82% vs Max Damage, 37.70% vs Public Counterplay, 57.23% vs Round464, and 51.17% vs Round465. Same-seed Round430 comparisons showed +0.59 pp vs Max Damage [-1.95, +3.32] and 0.00 pp vs Public Counterplay [-2.73, +2.93]; neither establishes hard-opponent improvement. Round430 remains the validated incumbent.
method: Each matchup: 128 held-out team-pair clusters × two repeated side-swapped local Showdown games (512 games). Cluster-bootstrap 95% intervals resample team-pair clusters. Same-seed controls use the same team pairs and evaluation seed schedule. No evaluation timeouts or action adjustments.

training.gpu: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU; about 84% utilization and 1.3 GB VRAM during PPO optimization
training.end_to_end_throughput_note: Exact aggregate rollout wall time was not retained because the first run stopped at a false-positive audit failure; no exact full-iteration games/s is claimed.

move_selection: Masked PPO action logits select moves. The win-probability head is an auxiliary training target; it does not rank normal actions. Search with a separate state evaluator is optional and disabled by default.
